svg.title: SEMCACHE gain along the coder stream
svg.desc: Coded output of a full run with SEMCACHE minus the same run without it: summed from the start of the stream (top), per MB of stream (middle), and the first 4.1 % enlarged (bottom). SEMCACHE saves 743,637 bytes in all; it is off in both metadata blocks.
svg.text: SEMCACHE gain along the coder stream
coded output of a full run with SEMCACHE minus the same run without it (same model, same coder stream of 501,062,281 B)
summed from the start of the stream
-743,637 B at the end of the stream
their mean over 1 %, within each part
position in the coder stream (100 % = 501.1 MB)

text.tspan: The first 4.1 % (20.5 MB), enlarged: summed from the start of the stream

svg.text: SEMCACHE off (+12 B over both blocks)
Both runs code the same stream with the same transformer, with an online BITLSTM in place of the three weight sets;
the curves compare their coded output at the same positions. SEMCACHE is off in both metadata blocks; the +12 B there
are a side effect of the other model layout. SEMCACHE makes the program 6.8 KB larger, which counts twice in S (compressor
and decompressor), so S shrinks by about 730 KB.
